description: This file defines the TermForm class for editing taxonomy terms in Drupal, including form building, validation, saving, and handling parent term relationships.

classes.name: TermForm
classes.description: A form class for editing taxonomy terms in Drupal, handling form display, validation, submission, and related logic.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the taxonomy term edit form, including parent term selection, weight, and relations details.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Defines form actions, including a custom 'overview' submit button if no 'destination' query parameter is present.

methods.name: overview
methods.description: Handles redirecting to the vocabulary overview page after form submission.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates form input, ensuring the 'weight' field is numeric.

methods.name: buildEntity
methods.description: Constructs the taxonomy term entity from form values, trimming the name and setting parent IDs.

methods.name: getEditedFieldNames
methods.description: Returns the list of edited fields, including 'parent' and 'weight'.

methods.name: flagViolations
methods.description: Manually flags validation violations for 'parent' and 'weight' fields.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the taxonomy term entity, displays status messages, logs actions, and redirects appropriately.

methods.name: getParentIds
methods.description: Retrieves parent IDs of a taxonomy term, including the root.
